units: <cite ref="Berakhot 57b:8">Ber. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>בכַנַּיְיהוּ חזי</he> (Ms. M. <he>בב׳</he>) he saw them (in his dream) in the regular places (as planted in the field). V. <cite ref="K00838"><he>כַּנְהָא</he></cite>.
Keth. 99ᵇ; Meïl. 21ᵇ כ׳ כ׳ בפרוטה each k. for a P’rutah (no reduction for larger quantities).—Pl. כַּנֵּי.
